collection.name: Showcase
collection.description: Made on the club's own GPUs, in as many styles as we could think of. Every piece records its model, prompt and seed, so it can be made again exactly.

items.title: Cathedral of compute
items.prompt: A tall gothic stained glass window depicting a server rack as a saintly figure, rays of coloured light falling across a stone floor, deep cobalt, ruby and amber glass with thick lead lines, photographed from inside a dim chapel

items.title: Couriers
items.prompt: Stop-motion claymation still, three small round clay robots carrying glowing parcels along a miniature street between cardboard houses, visible fingerprints in the clay, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, cheerful

items.title: Rush hour on the motherboard
items.prompt: Extreme macro photograph of tiny toy robots the size of ants walking in a line along the copper traces of a green circuit board, towering capacitors and a chip like a city block behind them, one robot waving, tilt-shift blur, warm rim light, crisp detail, no text, no lettering

items.title: Koi crossing
items.prompt: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print, a giant orange and white koi leaping out of a river over an arched wooden bridge where a small round robot stands holding a paper umbrella, falling cherry blossom petals, stylised curling water, flat areas of indigo, vermilion, pale green and cream, visible wood grain and paper texture, no text, no calligraphy, no seals, no signature

items.title: The rig in the garage
items.prompt: Isometric miniature diorama of a suburban garage with one wall cut away, inside a tiny glowing computer rig on a workbench next to a bicycle, a washing machine and a sleeping dog, pastel mint, peach and lilac, soft clay-render look, plain pale background, tilt-shift, no text

items.title: Still life with graphics card
items.prompt: Thick impasto oil painting, a still life of a graphics card propped against a blue ceramic jug with three lemons and a draped ochre cloth, heavy palette-knife strokes and ridges of paint catching the light, post-impressionist colour, cobalt, lemon yellow and viridian, no text

items.title: Rooftop, 16 bits
items.prompt: 16-bit pixel art scene, a city rooftop at dusk with a water tank, a satellite dish, potted plants and a black cat watching a meteor shower, magenta and cyan vaporwave sky with a huge pixel sun, crisp square pixels, limited palette, dithering, retro console game background, no text, no HUD

items.title: Stitched fox
items.prompt: Hand embroidery on natural linen stretched in a wooden hoop, a leaping fox whose fur is stitched as circuit traces and tiny solder dots, satin stitch and french knots in tangerine, teal, magenta and gold thread, loose thread ends, photographed from above on a wooden table, no text

items.title: Plans for a teapot automaton
items.prompt: Cyanotype blueprint, a technical exploded-view drawing of a friendly teapot-shaped robot with tiny legs, gears, springs and a windup key, fine white lines on deep prussian blue paper, construction circles and dashed centre lines, creases in the paper, no text, no labels, no numbers, no writing

items.title: Neon jellyfish
items.prompt: A glowing neon tube sign in the shape of a jellyfish mounted on a wet brick wall in a narrow alley at night, hot pink, electric blue and lime tubes, visible glass bends and wiring, reflections in a puddle below, light rain, cinematic photograph, no text, no letters, no words

items.title: Paper forest
items.prompt: Layered paper-cut shadow box, a forest of cut paper trees in a dozen receding layers with a stag on a ridge and a huge backlit moon, each layer casting a soft shadow, emerald, teal, burnt orange and ivory paper, visible paper edges and fibres, no text

items.title: Infrared orchard
items.prompt: Colour infrared photograph of an orchard in summer, foliage and grass rendered candy pink and white, near-black sky with bright white clouds, a weathered satellite dish standing between the rows of trees, a gravel path, sharp surreal light, medium format film grain, no text

items.title: First Light (cover)
items.prompt: Square album cover, marbled paper made by floating inks on water, slow swirling veins of peach, soft gold and pale blue around one bright unbroken circle like a rising sun, fine combed patterns, visible paper fibres, calm and luminous, no text, no letters

items.title: Tailnet Drive (cover)
items.prompt: Square album cover, low-poly 3D render of an empty coastal highway at night curving between faceted mountains and a flat teal sea, the red tail lights of one small car far ahead, a huge hot orange moon on the horizon, sharp triangular facets, glowing road markings, no text, no letters

items.title: Porch Light (cover)
items.prompt: Square album cover, hand-carved linocut print in two colours, a hanging porch lamp with moths circling it and an acoustic guitar leaning on a wooden chair, bold carved lines and rough gouge marks, mustard yellow and forest green ink on cream paper, slightly uneven print, warm and homemade, no text, no letters

items.title: First Light
items.prompt: ambient neoclassical, felt piano, slow warm strings, soft tape hiss, hopeful, 70 bpm, instrumental

items.title: Tailnet Drive
items.prompt: synthwave, driving analog bass, gated drums, bright arpeggiated synth lead, night drive, 110 bpm, instrumental

items.title: Porch Light
items.prompt: indie folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, warm female vocal, close harmonies, intimate, 92 bpm
items.lyrics:
[verse]
Left the porch light on for you
Moths are writing in the blue
Every house along the lane
Hums a little, just the same

[chorus]
Send it down the wire to me
I'll send it back by morning
What we have, we have to share
A little light, a little warning

[verse]
Someone's kettle, someone's fan
Someone's doing what they can
All these rooms, a single sky
Passing notes as they go by

[chorus]
Send it down the wire to me
I'll send it back by morning
What we have, we have to share
A little light, a little warning

items.title: Welcome to the club
items.prompt: Welcome to inference club. Every picture, song and voice on this page, including this one, was made on a graphics card in somebody's house.

items.title: Four lines about a porch light
items.prompt: Write a four-line poem about a porch light left on for a neighbour. No title.
items.text:
A steady glow against the night,
A quiet watch from wood and paint.
It signals safety, soft and bright,
For neighbours walking home late.

items.title: What a porch light is for
items.prompt: In one short sentence, say what a porch light is for.
items.text: A porch light is for illuminating the entryway to guide visitors and enhance security.<|im_end|>
